verdict.rationale: Railway offers condition-based alerts (Slack/Discord/email) that fire automatically when thresholds are met, which is a limited form of autonomous background automation, but there is no evidence of scheduled jobs/cron, multi-step workflow automations, or AI-agent-triggered autonomous tasks beyond a generic mention of an MCP server for 'AI-powered workflows.' missing for 10: evidence of scheduled/cron jobs, documented autonomous workflow automation beyond alerting, and any first-party or independent proof of agentic background task execution.
